name: startup_indoor_above_cool_nat_vent_not_running
description: Startup: reactivation ceiling gate blocks nat-vent when indoor already exceeds comfort_cool (Issue #392)

verdict.summary: When startup has indoor exceeding comfort_cool, the archetype-aware ceiling gate (Issue #392 Fix 1) blocks nat-vent (re)activation for the default/HVAC-fan archetype used here — the single-engine harness now exercises this directly since the gate lives in production's reactivation gates, not a separate simulator-only check.
verdict.observed_behavior: startup with indoor 76F > comfort_cool 74F, sensors open — nat-vent activation is blocked; HVAC pauses instead
verdict.expected_behavior: Ceiling gate blocks nat-vent activation because indoor 76F > ceiling_threshold 74F; door/window pause path applies instead.

events.note: Warm day restart: indoor 76F above comfort_cool 74F, outdoor 68F

Classification cycle runs first [Issue #1211: classifier-true setup -- high 80 / low 60 on a warm day means windows ARE recommended 06:00-10:00 (classify_day); the open window below is therefore inside the planned period]

Sensor opens: outdoor 68F < indoor 76F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F, but indoor 76F > ceiling_threshold 74F. Issue #392 Fix 1: the reactivation gate now blocks nat-vent activation in this case for the default/HVAC-fan archetype — production pauses instead.
Issue #1211: lets the coordinator listener path (zero-second debounce timer) fire after the 08:05 open; no assertion depends on it

assertions.reason: Classification applied. Ceiling gate governs the subsequent sensor-open event.

Indoor 76F > ceiling_threshold 74F blocks nat-vent (re)activation (Issue #392 Fix 1) — HVAC pauses for the open sensor instead. This closes the gap this scenario originally documented: pre-#392, no reactivation gate checked the ceiling, so production and simulator would have diverged. Now production's own gate blocks it, verifiable directly through the single-engine harness.

notes: Issue #1537 (owner-approved golden change; re-derived 2026-11-13, owner approved: harness thermostats report hvac_action (#1537)): decisions and service calls are unchanged; only incident_detected.thermostat_action changed (None -> off). (a) Effectiveness: unchanged, no decision, service call, assertion or promise outcome moved. (b) Docs<->production: docs/sim-harness-spec.md (#1537 default reporting). (c) Occupant: nothing the occupant sees changed; the golden now runs on a thermostat that reports its equipment like a real one.

Issue #1211 (C1): this scenario used to hand-set windows_recommended=false on a warm day with a 60 F low, which classify_day never produces; with A3 the planned-window period no longer exempts the handler, so the setup is made classifier-true (flag, 06:00-10:00 times, forecast high 80 / low 60) and the outcomes are unchanged: with no fan configured the handler pauses at the open window. Coordinator mode needs a later event for the open's debounce timer to fire before the run ends.
